claim_text: President Tinubu signed the Electricity Act 2023 repealing the 2005 EPSRA and granting constitutional powers to state governments to regulate subnational electricity markets

claim_text: Over four states including Enugu, Ekiti, Ondo, and Imo established independent State Electricity Regulatory Commissions taking over regulatory oversight from NERC
notes: NERC regulatory transfer orders and state gazettes

notes: FIRS 2023 Annual Report and NBS quarterly fiscal tables

claim_text: 15 commercial vehicle CNG conversion centres operationalized across six pilot states

42,000 metric tonnes of maize, sorghum, and millet released from Strategic Grain Reserves to 36 states

30,000 technical fellows trained and certified in Phase 1 across 12 digital tech disciplines in 36 states

17.5km dualized access bypasses completed connecting Second Niger Bridge to Onitsha and Asaba expressways
3,112 residential housing units under active structural construction in Karsana Abuja under Renewed Hope Cities Phase 1
